permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Loads research, study, translations and voice search. Processes selected bottle photos with Supabase. Shared wine details and artwork enter our shared master catalog; personal notes stay private. Optional D3 account pairing syncs your own wines and study progress.

permissions.name: album
permissions.desc: Choose bottle photographs for your Winebrary and shared catalog, or a private profile photo for your linked account.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Photograph a wine label for identification after you choose to research it.
